_readme: Embodied carbon factors for RateGen's carbon rates. A library material is matched by 'pattern' (case-insensitive regular expression on '<category> :: <name>'). factor is kgCO2e per kg of material (A1-A3, cradle to gate) or, for fuels, kgCO2e per unit burnt on site (A5a). mass converts the library unit to kg; massAssumed marks a mass that is an assumption rather than stated by the item, and RateGen says so on screen. a4 is transport to site (BEIS 2020 via CIDB 2021 and IStructE 2020: 0.005 kgCO2e/kg local, 50 km by road; 0.032 national, 300 km by road). A5w (site waste) = wf x (A1-A3 + A4 + C2 + C3-C4), C2 0.005 kgCO2e/kg, C3-C4 0.013 (1.77 for timber) (IStructE 2020; CIDB 2021). Labour carries no material carbon; worker transport (A5.4) is not counted. The first matching entry wins.
method: RICS Whole life carbon assessment for the built environment (2nd ed., 2023), upfront carbon A1-A5, calculated as IStructE How to calculate embodied carbon (2020)
sources: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data)
IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3
UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2024 (DESNZ), Scope 1 fuels
Dangote Cement 2024 Annual Report; Lafarge Africa 2024 Annual Report
Etex / Eternit corrugated fibre cement sheet EPDs (EN 15804+A2), via the One Click LCA materials database

factors.label: Diesel (AGO) burnt on site
factors.factorSource: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2024 (DESNZ), Scope 1 fuels: Diesel (100% mineral diesel) 2.66155 kgCO2e per litre
factors.massBasis: per litre burnt
factors.wfBasis: no published waste factor; site waste not counted

factors.label: Petrol (PMS) burnt on site
factors.factorSource: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2024 (DESNZ), Scope 1 fuels: Petrol (100% mineral petrol) 2.35372 kgCO2e per litre
factors.massBasis: per litre burnt
factors.wfBasis: no published waste factor; site waste not counted

factors.label: LPG burnt on site
factors.factorSource: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors 2024 (DESNZ), Scope 1 fuels: LPG 2,939.36 kgCO2e per tonne
factors.massBasis: 13 kg per cylinder, as named
factors.wfBasis: no published waste factor; site waste not counted

factors.label: Cement
factors.pattern: ^cement based products :: (cement \((50kg|jumbo) bag\)|coloured cement|white cement)$|^ :: cement\b
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Cement (commonly used)' 0.83 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 50 kg per bag, 1,000 kg per tonne, as named
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 5%, waste factor 0.053 (concrete in situ)
factors.lowSource: Nigerian producers' own reporting, Scope 1 only (the kiln and its fuel): Dangote Cement 2024 Annual Report, 570 kg CO2 per tonne; Lafarge Africa 2024, 537 kg net CO2 per tonne of cementitious. It leaves out purchased power, quarrying and raw-material transport, so it is a floor, not the full A1-A3

factors.label: Sand
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'General aggregate and sand' 0.0049 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: loose bulk density 1,600 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 5%, waste factor 0.053 (concrete in situ)

factors.label: Crushed rock, granite
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Gravel, crushed' 0.01 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: loose bulk density 1,600 kg/m3; 1,000 kg per tonne
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 5%, waste factor 0.053 (concrete in situ)

factors.label: Hardcore, laterite, gravel
factors.pattern: ^crushed rock products :: hardcore|^earthwork and filling materials :: (laterite|unwashed gravel|washed gravel)|^ :: .*(hardcore|laterite)
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'General aggregate and sand' 0.0049 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: loose bulk density 1,600 kg/m3; 1,000 kg per tonne
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 5%, waste factor 0.053 (concrete in situ)

factors.label: Reinforcement bar, scrap-based EAF
factors.pattern: ^(high tensile|mild) steel bar reinforcement :: |^ :: .*(reinforcement bar|rebar|high yield)
factors.factorSource: CARES EPD 0060 (2026, EN 15804+A2): carbon steel reinforcing bar, secondary (scrap-based) EAF route, Kroman Celik, Turkiye, GWP-total A1-A3 821 kg CO2e per tonne. Chosen because Nigeria's rebar mills (Kam Industries, African Foundries) melt scrap in electric furnaces and Turkiye supplies much of the imported rebar; the world average (IStructE 2020, 1.99) is mostly blast-furnace steel
factors.massBasis: 1,000 kg per tonne
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 5%, waste factor 0.053 (steel reinforcement)

factors.label: Binding wire
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Steel, wire rod' 2.27 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 25 kg per roll, as named
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 5%, waste factor 0.053 (steel reinforcement)

factors.label: Steel fabric mesh, BS 4483
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Cold-rolled reinforcing steel and electrowelded mesh' 0.77 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: BS 4483 nominal mass (A142 2.22, A193 3.02, A252 3.95 kg/m2) x 4.8 x 2.4 m sheet
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 5%, waste factor 0.053 (steel reinforcement)

factors.label: Steel plate
factors.pattern: ^structural steel plates :: |^structural steel sections :: steel plate, supply
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Steel plate' 2.46 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 1,000 kg per tonne; sheets from the size as named x 7,850 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (steel frame)

factors.label: Structural steel sections
factors.pattern: ^structural steel sections :: (universal beam|rolled steel)|^structural steel :: structural steel$|^ :: .*(universal (beam|column)|h section|structural steel)
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: structural sections, worldwide (Worldsteel LCI) 1.55 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 1,000 kg per tonne
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (steel frame)

factors.label: Nails and screws
factors.pattern: ^nails and screws and other accessories :: .*\(25kg bag\)$
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Steel, wire rod' 2.27 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 25 kg per bag, as named
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (steel frame)

factors.label: Sandcrete hollow blocks
factors.pattern: ^cement based products :: .*hollow blocks$|^ :: .*blocks? per square met
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Concrete block 10 MPa' 0.0781 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: mass from NIS 87:2007 block sizes (450 x 225 x 225 mm, 50 mm webs; 450 x 225 x 150 mm, 37.5 mm webs; two cells) at the 1,920 kg/m3 minimum density recommended for Nigerian sandcrete (Structville, citing NIS 87): 225 mm 27.5 kg, 150 mm 18.2 kg; NIS 87 lists no hollow 100 mm block, so 100 mm is taken as solid, 19.4 kg
factors.wfBasis: IStructE (2020): waste rate 1%, waste factor 0.010 (precast concrete)
factors.lowSource: the block's cement (NIS 1:8 mix, about 20 x 225 mm blocks per 50 kg bag, Structville: 2.5 kg cement per 27.5 kg block) taken at the Nigerian producers' Scope 1 figure, 0.57 kgCO2e/kg (Dangote 2024), instead of 0.83

factors.label: Softwood, sawn
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: softwood studwork/framing, 100% FSC/PEFC 0.263 kgCO2e/kg (sequestration excluded)
factors.massBasis: section and length as named x 500 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (timber, plywood)

factors.label: Hardwood, sawn
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Timber, Hardwood' 0.31 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: section and length as named x 700 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (timber, plywood)

factors.label: Plywood
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: plywood, 100% FSC/PEFC 0.681 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: board size as named x 600 kg/m3 (the density CIDB 2021 uses)
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (timber, plywood)

factors.label: Aluminium roofing sheet
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: aluminium sheet, worldwide consumption (31% recycled) 13.0 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: thickness as named x 2,700 kg/m3; ridges 0.7 mm x 600 mm girth
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (steel frame), applied to sheet metal

factors.label: Sheet glass
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: glass, general 1.44 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: pane size and thickness as named x 2,500 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.29 (glass)

factors.label: Ceramic and vitrified tiles
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Ceramic tile (commonly used)' 0.78 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: tile thickness as named x 2,000 kg/m3; 20 kg per m2 where no thickness is named
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (ceramic)

factors.label: Vinyl floor tiles
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Vinyl tile (floor)' 1.23 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: tile thickness as named x 1,400 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (ceramic)

factors.label: Emulsion (water-based) paint
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Waterborne paint' 2.54 kgCO2e/kg (ICE 2019)
factors.massBasis: litres as named x 1.3 kg/litre
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.111 (paint)

factors.label: Gloss, oil and alkyd paint
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Alkyd paint, 60% in solvent' 3.21 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: litres as named x 1.3 kg/litre
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.111 (paint)

factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'General paint' 2.91 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: litres as named x 1.3 kg/litre
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.111 (paint)

factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Waterborne paint' 2.54 kgCO2e/kg (ICE 2019)
factors.massBasis: litres as named x 1.3 kg/litre
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.111 (paint)

factors.label: Paint, primer, coating
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'General paint' 2.91 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: litres as named x 1.3 kg/litre; kg as named
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.111 (paint)

factors.label: Bitumen
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Bitumen, straight-run' 0.19 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 1,000 kg per tonne
factors.wfBasis: no published waste factor; site waste not counted

factors.label: Bitumen emulsion
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Bitumen emulsion' 0.22 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 1,000 kg per tonne
factors.wfBasis: no published waste factor; site waste not counted

factors.label: Asphalt
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Asphalt for road, 5% binder content' 0.06 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 1,000 kg per tonne
factors.wfBasis: no published waste factor; site waste not counted

factors.label: Fibre cement (asbestos-cement) roofing sheet
factors.factorSource: Etex / Eternit corrugated fibre cement sheet EPDs (EN 15804+A2), A1-A3: 7.98 kgCO2e/m2 at 13.9 kg/m2 (0.574 kgCO2e/kg) and 8.35 kgCO2e/m2 at 14 kg/m2 (0.596 kgCO2e/kg); mean 0.585 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 14 kg per m2 of 6 mm corrugated sheet, as the EPDs state; ridge capping 7 kg per m at about 500 mm girth
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010, applied to sheet cladding; laps are already in the line's quantity

factors.label: Galvanised steel ('zinc') roofing sheet
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Hot dip galvanized steel with pure zinc coating' 2.56 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 0.30 mm steel sheet x 7,850 kg/m3 = 2.36 kg per m2; ridge 1.2 kg per m
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (steel frame), applied to sheet metal

factors.label: Timber door
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Door, inner, wood' 55.2 kgCO2e per m2 of door; at an assumed 25 kg per m2 that is 2.208 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: door size as named (W x H) at 25 kg per m2 for a 44 mm door
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010, applied to a factory-made unit

factors.label: Aluminium framed glazed window or door
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: aluminium 13.0 and glass 1.44 kgCO2e/kg, as a unit of equal masses of frame and 4 mm glass (7.22 kgCO2e/kg). CIDB (2021) gives 279 kgCO2e for an aluminium framed window, which this matches for a 1.8 x 1.2 m window
factors.massBasis: window or door size as named (W x H) at 20 kg per m2: 10 kg of aluminium frame and 10 kg of 4 mm glass
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010, applied to a factory-made unit

factors.label: Fibreboard (softboard) ceiling
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Timber, Fibreboard' 0.72 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 13 mm board at about 280 kg/m3 = 3.6 kg per m2
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010; the build-up's own waste line is not added again

factors.label: Fibre cement (asbestos) ceiling board
factors.factorSource: Etex / Eternit fibre cement sheet EPDs (EN 15804+A2), A1-A3, mean 0.585 kgCO2e/kg (as the fibre cement roofing sheet)
factors.massBasis: board thickness as named in the rate (e.g. 1200 x 1200 x 3mm) at 1,500 kg/m3; 6 kg per m2 when no thickness is named
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010; the build-up's own waste line is not added again

factors.label: Aluminium strip ceiling
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: aluminium sheet, worldwide consumption (31% recycled) 13.0 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: 0.5 mm strips covering 84% of the area plus carriers, about 1.5 kg per m2
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010, applied to sheet metal

factors.label: Bolts, drive screws and fixing lugs
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Steel, wire rod' 2.27 kgCO2e/kg (as nails and screws)
factors.massBasis: about 30 g per bolt, drive screw or lug
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (steel frame)

factors.label: Wire nails
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data): 'Steel, wire rod' 2.27 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: kg as stated; 25 kg per bag
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (steel frame)

factors.label: Sawn softwood (named in the build-up)
factors.factorSource: IStructE (2020) How to calculate embodied carbon, Table 2.3 (ICE v3.0 / EPDs), A1-A3: softwood studwork/framing, 100% FSC/PEFC 0.263 kgCO2e/kg (sequestration excluded)
factors.massBasis: section as named: (W x D mm) by the length in metres, or (T mm) by the area in m2, at 500 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010 (timber, plywood)

factors.label: PVC pipe
factors.factorSource: CIDB Malaysia (2021) Embodied Carbon Inventory Data for Construction Materials, cradle-to-gate (compiled from ICE v3.0, EPDs and national LCA data), pipe: 'PVC' 3.23 kgCO2e/kg
factors.massBasis: nominal diameter as named, wall at one 26th of the diameter (SDR 26), 1,400 kg/m3
factors.wfBasis: CIDB (2021) worked example: waste factor 0.010

factors.label: Transport to site of a stated mass
factors.factorSource: No product carbon: the line moves material priced elsewhere. Transport only (A4): BEIS 2020 via CIDB 2021 and IStructE 2020, 0.032 kgCO2e/kg, national, 300 km by road
factors.massBasis: 1,000 kg per tonne, as stated
factors.wfBasis: transport only; no site waste
